<div class="rizado-widget">
  <svg
    class="rizado-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 858 609"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Rizadora - Línea número 2"

    <defs>

      <!-- Metal de poleas -->

      <linearGradient
        id="riz-roller-metal"
        x1="15%" y1="0%"
        x2="85%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2" />
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="43%" class="riz-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA" />
        <stop offset="74%" class="riz-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Paneles y soportes -->

      <linearGradient
        id="riz-panel-metal"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="0%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="riz-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="riz-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="riz-top-metal"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="75%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EEF0F2" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="100%" class="riz-metal-base" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="riz-side-metal"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="100%" y2="35%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C6C9CF" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#D1D3D8" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B5B9C1" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Sombra de contacto y sombra ambiental de poleas -->

      <filter
        id="riz-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%" y="-30%"
        width="160%" height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="ambientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="ambientBlur"
          dx="0.3" dy="2"
          result="ambientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="ambientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="ambientColor"
          in2="ambientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="ambientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="contactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="contactBlur"
          dx="0" dy="0.65"
          result="contactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="contactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="contactColor"
          in2="contactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="contactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="ambientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="contactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra suave de equipos -->

      <filter
        id="riz-equipment-shadow"
        x="-20%" y="-20%"
        width="140%" height="150%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="equipmentAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="equipmentAmbientBlur"
          dx="0" dy="2.5"
          result="equipmentAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="equipmentAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="equipmentAmbientColor"
          in2="equipmentAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="equipmentAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="equipmentContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="equipmentContactBlur"
          dx="0" dy="0.8"
          result="equipmentContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="equipmentContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="equipmentContactColor"
          in2="equipmentContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="equipmentContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="equipmentAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="equipmentContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Perforado discreto del gabinete -->

      <pattern
        id="riz-ventilation"
        width="5"
        height="5"
        patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <circle
          class="riz-vent-dot"

        />
        <circle

        />
      </pattern>

      <!--

        El conjunto se orienta según la tubería de la referencia.
      -->

      <g id="riz-valve-symbol">
        <path
          class="riz-valve-body"

"use strict";

/*
 * RIZADO — Rizadora, Línea #2.
 *
 * Widget gráfico estático.
 *
 * La geometría, los acabados metálicos y las sombras
 * se definen íntegramente mediante SVG y CSS.
 *
 * No utiliza tags, variables del PLC, temporizadores,
 * animaciones ni recursos externos.
 */
